question: Which of the following components of a walk-in cooler is used to mount condensing unit assembly?
solution:
The correct answer is __Condenser unit rack**(Option 4)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The condenser unit rack is used to mount the condensing unit assembly in a walk-in cooler.
 
• It ensures the stability and proper positioning of the condensing unit.
 
• This component is essential for the efficient functioning of the cooling system.
 
• Other components like the condensate water evaporator and drain line heater serve different functions within the cooler system.

**Additional Information__**

 
• **Condensate Water Evaporator:**

 
 
• It helps in evaporating condensate water produced during cooling.
 
• This component prevents water accumulation inside the cooler.
 
 
 
• **Drain Line Heater:**
 
 
• It prevents freezing of drain lines in cold environments.
 
• This ensures uninterrupted drainage of condensate water.
 
 
 
• **Heat Exchanger:**
 
 
• It transfers heat between two mediums to regulate temperature inside the cooler.
 
• Used for efficient cooling and energy conservation.
